units_caps_and_deadlines._honest_limit_on_what_the_deadline_prote: TMO_U2U3 is 176,280 s ~ 49 hours. THIS BOX WAS POWERED OFF AFTER 7 h 49 m on the night this item's predecessor ran, and its longest recorded uptime this week is under 23 h. A 49-hour in-container deadline is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT: the binding protection is the box's own uptime, and a poweroff is an infrastructure kill that no cap can convert into a cap-stop. The real protection against an over-long run on a busy box is the per-point ledger row, which lands after every point and survives the kill. Section 4.4 states this on its face.
